ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in Figure 1, it is known that $\angle AOB = 90^\circ$, OE and OD bisect $\angle AOB$ and $\angle BOC$ respectively. If $\angle EOD = 64^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle BOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: \textbf{Solution:} It is known from the problem that $\angle BOC = \boxed{38^\circ}$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In Figure 1 on the left, all rays start from point O; from top to bottom, OA is seen vertically upward, OE slants to the upper right, OB is horizontal to the right, OD slants to the lower right, and OC is further to the lower right. Therefore, OB lies inside ∠EOD, and ∠EOD is composed by adding ∠EOB and ∠BOD. Reasoning: It is known that ∠AOB = 90°, and OE bisects ∠AOB, so ∠EOB = 90° ÷ 2 = 45°. Let ∠BOC = x. OD bisects ∠BOC, so ∠BOD = x/2. From the ray positions in Figure 1, ∠EOD = ∠EOB + ∠BOD, therefore 64° = 45° + x/2. Solving gives x/2 = 19°, so x = 38°. Therefore ∠BOC = 38°.
